header: Editions with their price and scope
lead: A list, not a table. A licence scope is a sentence about who may use it and where, and that does not fit in a cell.
note: The note holds the terms that apply to every edition: tax, maintenance, transfer and governing law.

tiers.title: The edition name is a heading
tiers.text: Each edition is a level-three heading in the page outline.

tiers.title: The price ends the row
tiers.text: Readers scan prices straight down, so the figures share one width.

tiers.title: The scope is a sentence
tiers.text: Workstations, addresses and redistribution rights, with more room than a table cell.

tiers.title: On a phone the row stacks
tiers.text: The price stays directly below its name, so it is clear which edition it belongs to.
